title: Training & New Products
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a high-performing strategic finance professional to join our growing Product Finance team. Training is one of Baseten's fastest-evolving businesses and it won't be the last new product line we launch. You'll own the economics of Training end to end and be the finance owner for new products as they go from idea to launch to scale, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and GTM leadership on the pricing, margin, and capacity decisions that shape each business. This is a builder role: much of what you'll own doesn't exist yet as a model, a dashboard, or a process.

This role is ideal for someone with 5 to 8 years of experience across strategic finance, investing, and/or investment banking who wants broad exposure to company-building inside a fast-scaling AI infrastructure company. Experience at a usage-based company is a plus.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and maintain cost-to-serve models for Training engagements across compute, delivery time, and reserved capacity

- Own Training pricing and recommend structures across committed engagements, usage-based pricing, and packaged offerings

- Track training capacity utilization and tie capacity plans to pipeline

- Run the monthly Training business review across bookings, utilization, margin, pipeline, and renewal and expansion trends

- Own the Training forecast and annual plan, including compute needs, unit costs, and multi-year P&L

- Partner with Product on new products from concept onward, building pre-launch business cases, cost-to-serve views, and go/no-go recommendations

- Set launch pricing and packaging for new products

- Define success metrics and scale criteria at launch

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Economics

- 5+ years of experience in strategic finance at a high-growth company, PE/VC investing, and/or investment banking

- Excellent financial modeling and analytical skills, including building unit economics or cost-to-serve models from raw usage and cost data

- Ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations for executives

- Comfortable building from scratch and making decisions with incomplete data in a fast-moving environment

- Strong attention to detail with a bias toward ownership and execution

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- High intellectual curiosity and interest in AI / infrastructure / developer tooling

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills; familiarity with SQL or BI tools is a plus

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with GPU compute economics or cloud infrastructure

- Familiarity with how ML model training and fine-tuning work

- Experience with product-led growth economics, such as free tiers, credits, and conversion

- Experience pricing or launching a new product line

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

- Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

👋 Somos Tendios , una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona. Nuestra misión es revolucionar el mundo de la contratación pública para empresas e instituciones.
Nuestra plataforma SaaS impulsada por inteligencia artificial ayuda a empresas a ganar más licitaciones y a entidades públicas a crear y gestionar licitaciones de forma más eficiente. Trabajamos con entidades como el Principado de Asturias, Renfe, Acciona o Telefónica, entre otras. Lo hacemos a través de dos productos:

• Tendios Bid - para empresas que participan en licitaciones públicas: buscador, alertas, pipeline de oportunidades y workflows para ganar más concursos.

• Tendios Create - para organizaciones públicas que crean y publican licitaciones: creación de expedientes y redacción de pliegos asistida por IA.

La IA no es un añadido en nuestros productos: es el núcleo. Redacción asistida, propuestas generadas, análisis automático de documentos y flujos conversacionales están en el centro de la experiencia. Buscamos a alguien que diseñe con esa mentalidad, no alrededor de ella.
Como un equipo joven y ambicioso, valoramos la energía, la creatividad y la colaboración. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres tener un impacto real, nos encantaría que te unas a nosotros para redefinir cómo las empresas optimizan sus procesos de licitación pública.
El rol
Buscamos a alguien que sea el dueño de producto de todo el ciclo del dato: desde que se captura en la fuente (collectors) hasta que llega al cliente como valor (listas, directorios, análisis de mercado y Tender Intelligence).
Es un rol híbrido: lidera un equipo técnico de scraping/collectors y, al mismo tiempo, define y entrega la capa de producto de analítica de mercado que usan los clientes de Bid. Es un puesto con mucho impacto directo: la calidad del dato condiciona la activación, la retención y la propuesta de valor de Tendios .
Responsabilidades
1. Gestión del equipo de Collectors

• Liderar y priorizar el trabajo del equipo de collectors (licitaciones, legislación, resoluciones y otras fuentes de contratación pública).

• Definir el roadmap de cobertura: nuevas fuentes, nuevos países/territorios, nuevos tipos de documento y mayor profundidad de campos.

• Evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada fuente (campos disponibles, frecuencia de actualización, estabilidad, coste de mantenimiento) antes de comprometer trabajo.

• Gestionar el backlog, el ritmo de entrega y la coordinación con Ingeniería y Data & AI.

• Garantizar la operación: monitorización de collectors, respuesta ante roturas de fuentes, SLAs de frescura y cobertura.

• Dar visibilidad al resto de la empresa sobre qué datos tenemos, con qué calidad y qué limitaciones.

2. ETL y Data Quality a nivel de producto

• Definir qué significa "dato de calidad" para Tendios : completitud, exactitud, consistencia, frescura, deduplicación y normalización.

• Establecer métricas y umbrales de calidad (por fuente, por país, por campo) y hacerles seguimiento con dashboards y alertas.

• Priorizar las mejoras del ETL en función del impacto en el producto: enriquecimiento, normalización de entidades (organismos y empresas), clasificación (CPV, tipologías, estados) y resolución de duplicados.

• Traducir problemas de calidad de dato en impacto de negocio (ruido en alertas, resultados irrelevantes, análisis incorrectos) y escalarlos con criterio.

• Definir la política de ciclo de vida del dato: estados de licitación, cambios, modificaciones, adjudicaciones y formalizaciones.

• Ser el punto de referencia para evaluar la readiness de nuevos mercados en términos de calidad y disponibilidad de datos.

3. Producto de analítica de mercado y oportunidades de cliente

• Analítica interna de las oportunidades de las empresas

• Directorios de empresas y de entidades públicas.

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is looking for an experienced Workplace Investigator to join our fast-paced Global Employee Relations team. You'll be the subject matter expert on high-risk employee matters: an objective investigator and the trusted escalation point for complex cases. You'll own EMEA cases hands-on and advise on APJ. You'll work closely with HR, Legal and business leaders to deliver fair, consistent and legally compliant outcomes across many jurisdictions. If you want real ownership, strategic influence and the chance to shape how a global ER function scales, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the full investigation lifecycle for EMEA allegations, including harassment, discrimination, retaliation and policy violations. This covers structured witness interviews, evidence analysis, and legally defensible reports and executive summaries.

• Keep investigations procedurally sound by aligning them with local statutory requirements (e.g., the ACAS Code of Practice in the UK) and global standards. Act as the final word on investigative methodology to ensure consistency and minimize bias.

• Advise managers and HR Business Partners across EMEA and APJ on sensitive ER issues, including disciplinary actions, written warnings, grievances, and regional legal and cultural considerations.

• Support restructures, job eliminations and involuntary exits in EMEA, ensuring compliance with local consultation requirements. Engage with works councils and employee representative bodies in partnership with Legal and HR, and give advisory support on similar activity in APJ.

• Analyze ER trends across EMEA and APJ monthly and quarterly to identify systemic risks. Use what you find to shape remediation strategies, policy improvements and manager training.

• Maintain accurate case documentation in the case management system. Standardize investigation templates, interview protocols and evidence-gathering procedures.

• Stay current on employment law, regulatory developments and ER best practice across EMEA, with working knowledge of APJ, and contribute to ER projects that support regional growth and transformation.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Staines office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 6+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in employee relations, workplace investigations or employment law within a fast-paced, global or matrixed organization.

• Strong practical knowledge of employment and labor laws across EMEA, with a proven track record of independently managing complex ER cases across multiple European jurisdictions.

• Expertise in workplace investigations, conflict resolution and sensitive employee matters. You can diagnose root causes and interpret ambiguous, multi-sided situations with balanced judgment.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to advise, build trust with and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with extensive experience drafting formal investigation reports, executive summaries and policy materials.

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of complex matters at once using

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration
description:
Job Purpose:
The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration is a senior, customer-facing technical contributor responsible for ensuring customers successfully integrate and get value from IMS 's mobile SDKs, which power telematics, mobility, and insurance technology solutions. Working primarily post-sales, this role acts as the technical bridge between IMS and its customers' mobile development teams, owning SDK integrations from kick-off through go-live and beyond across native iOS and Android and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). The role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, making independent technical and customer-facing decisions, and to proactively shape how IMS supports and delivers SDK integrations.
This position is ideal for an experienced mobile SDK developer, or an experienced app developer with strong SDK integration experience, who also brings consultative, customer-facing experience who enjoys a balance of hands-on coding and advising others. The successful candidate will be comfortable working inside customer codebases to diagnose and resolve integration issues, explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and using real-world customer insight to drive improvements to IMS 's SDK, support model, and delivery processes.
Key Responsibilities:
Customer SDK Integration & Delivery

• Independently own the technical delivery of IMS SDK integrations for customers, from technical kick-off and environment setup through testing, go-live, and early-life support.

• Guide customer engineering teams through integrating the IMS SDK into native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, including SDK components built with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).

• Advise customers on SDK configuration for trip detection, crash detection, and related features, including the appropriate setup for phone-only, Bluetooth-enabled device, and OBD-based use cases.

• Support customers in implementing SDK authentication and user session management, including token-based (e.g. JWT) authentication flows.

• Build sample code, reference implementations, and proof-of-concept apps to help customers adopt SDK features quickly and correctly.

• Ensure customers correctly implement platform permissions and background behaviour (location, motion, Bluetooth, notifications) required for reliable data capture.

Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Support

• Independently diagnose and resolve complex customer integration issues by reviewing customer code, SDK logs, device behaviour, and backend data.

• Reproduce customer-reported issues across devices, OS versions, and frameworks, and determine whether the root cause sits in the customer app, the SDK, or the platform.

• Act as the senior technical point of contact for customer escalations relating to SDK integrations, working with the Service Desk and engineering teams to drive issues to resolution.

• Raise clear, well-evidenced defect reports and feature requests for the SDK engineering teams, including reproduction steps and supporting data.

• Contribute fixes or improvements to SDK wrappers, sample apps, and integration tooling where appropriate.

Customer Consultation & Enablement

• Build trusted technical relationships with customer engineering teams, product owners, and stakeholders.

• Run technical workshops, integration reviews, and onboarding sessions to help customers understand SDK capabilities, best practices, and trade-offs.

• Advise customers on mobile best practices that affect telematics data quality, such as battery optimisation, background execution limits, and OS-specific restrictions.

• Translate customer business requirements into practical technical integration approaches.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, setting realistic expectations on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Process Improvement & Technical Leadership

• Proactively identify gaps and inefficiencies

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 7+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex board designs

Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is. In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving. title: Vice President(VP) of Growth
description:
ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSE
Everyday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee. We're a fast-growing, nine-figure D2C brand with a loyal, high-retention subscriber base, and we're scaling our retention function to match our ambitions.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re hiring a Vice President, Growth to own Everyday Dose’s direct-to-consumer acquisition and retention engine. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll lead paid acquisition, conversion, retention and lifecycle, creative strategy, and growth analytics-and be accountable for growth and cohort health as a single result.
The mandate is to drive aggressive new-customer growth while protecting what makes the business valuable: strong retention and customer lifetime value. We need a leader who understands that sustainable growth isn’t simply about buying more volume. You’ll build an acquisition engine that maintains or improves cohort quality as we scale while operating within a disciplined 12-month payback ceiling.
This is a senior leadership role with ownership of the DTC growth strategy and P&L, significant media investment, and a multidisciplinary Growth team spanning Performance Marketing, Retention & Lifecycle, Creative Strategy, and Growth Analytics.
This role is full-time and can be based at our Austin, TX headquarters or remotely within the U.S. Austin is preferred. Travel of up to 20% may be required for HQ visits, team offsites, and agency and partner meetings.
Requirements
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
You’ll take primary ownership of the core pillars of our DTC growth engine:

• Growth Strategy & DTC P&L: Set the annual and quarterly DTC growth plan, targets, and budget, owning new-customer volume, CAC, payback, and M3/M12 retention as one scorecard.

• Paid Acquisition & Media: Lead performance and upper-funnel media across paid social, search, TV/CTV, creators, and affiliates.

• Conversion & Funnel Performance: Own the customer journey from first impression through first order, including landing pages, offers, site experience, and subscription checkout.

• Retention & Lifecycle: Lead subscription onboarding, email and SMS, win-back, churn reduction, and broader lifecycle strategy with a focus on improving cohort retention.

• Creative Strategy: Direct creative strategy and testing across acquisition channels and build a repeatable process for briefing, testing, and scaling creative.

• Measurement & Growth Analytics: Own cohort-level reporting, incrementality testing, attribution, and the measurement framework behind growth investment.

• Team Leadership: Hire, develop, and lead a multidisciplinary Growth organization while partnering closely with Finance, Operations, Product, and Brand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set the growth strategy: Build the annual and quarterly DTC growth plan, establish targets and budgets, and manage new-customer volume, CAC, payback, and retention together rather than as isolated metrics.

• Own the DTC P&L: Maintain a clear view of growth performance and tradeoffs and communicate results and recommendations to the CEO and leadership team.

• Lead paid acquisition: Set strategy across paid social, search, TV/CTV, creators, and affiliates and allocate spend based on cohort quality and payback-not CPM or volume alone.

• Build the right media model: Manage agency partners, hold them accountable to clear outcomes, and determine which capabilities should be built in-house.

• Improve conversion: Own the path from first impression through first order and improve landing pages, offers, site experience, and subscription checkout without relying on deep or evergreen discounting.

• Drive retention: Lead onboarding, email and SMS, win-back, and churn-reduction programs with a focus on improving M3 and M12 retention by acquisition cohort.

title: Graduate Infrastructure Solutions Engineer 2027
description:
Location: Bristol, UK
Start date: September 2027
Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.

The Graduate Programme at Graphcore

Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.

 

What you’ll work on

Put your technical foundations to work on the infrastructure solutions that keeps Graphcore’s engineering teams connected, productive and secure. As a Graduate IS Engineer, you’ll support infrastructure operations, investigate technical issues and contribute to projects that improve reliability, performance and security. Your work will span servers, storage, networking, cloud platforms, automation and monitoring. You’ll learn how these systems support AI engineering at scale, building practical experience with Linux, Windows, scripting and infrastructure as code. It’s a chance to see how the technology behind an engineering organisation works and help make it better.

Your team and support

The Infrastructure Solutions team designs, builds and supports the IT environments that help Graphcore engineers work at scale. The team spans on-premise infrastructure, cloud, networking, automation and security. You’ll learn from experienced engineers through hands-on problem solving, planned projects and technical discussions. You’ll take ownership of useful, well-scoped work early, with support as you build your knowledge and confidence.

You’ll gain hands-on experience as you rotate through our IS teams, including Cloud and Application Security, Cybersecurity Operations, Networking, Data Centre Operations and more. Along the way, Martinus and Peter will provide mentoring and support to help you build your skills, grow your confidence and take the next steps in your career.

We use evidence, service impact and practical trade-offs to guide our decisions. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when you spot a problem or need support.

How you’ll learn and grow

During the two-year programme, you’ll build infrastructure skills by working on real operational issues and improvement projects. Investigating technical issues will help you develop a methodical approach to problem solving and understand how servers, storage, networks and cloud services fit together. Work on scripting, automation and infrastructure as code will give you practical ways to improve how infrastructure is managed. Working alongside experienced engineers will help you weigh up reliability, performance and security, explain your approach and understand how infrastructure decisions affect the teams who depend on these services.

What we're looking for

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field

• Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments

• An understanding of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing or firewalls

• Introductory scripting experience with Python, Bash or PowerShell

Bring an interest in infrastructure, cloud technologies, systems engineering or platform operations, and motivation to learn through practical problem solving. You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, internships, hobbies or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned.

Benefits

• Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility

• Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension

• Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Root is on a mission to unbreak insurance by creating experiences people love at prices they can't believe. We believe that investing in world-class technology will facilitate a new class of insurance products, driving a massive positive impact on the hundreds of millions of drivers who carry auto insurance in the US. Root's Engineering team is committed to building a flexible platform on which our product designers and quantitative scientists can quickly test ideas, deploy them into production, and iterate, with the ultimate objective of a delightful customer experience coupled with effective risk management.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to lead our Data Security domain and help define how the organization protects sensitive data at scale. In this role, you will contribute to the data security roadmap and help establish the standards, control requirements, and risk priorities across the data lifecycle.

You will partner closely with Data Platform, Analytics, Engineering, Security Operations, and GRC teams to protect policyholder and corporate data in cloud-native environments. Your responsibilities will include data discovery and classification, encryption and key management, data obfuscation and de-identification, fine-grained access controls, secure data sharing, retention and deletion, backup protection, monitoring, and data loss prevention.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will establish secure patterns and standards, influence technical decisions, automate repeatable workflows, and help teams adopt practical controls that enable secure use of data for business and analytics purposes.

Salary Range : $111,500 - $139,400 (Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering)

Root is a "work where it works best" company. This means we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US.

How You Will Make an Impact

• Help establish the data security strategy and roadmap for sensitive policyholder, customer, employee, and corporate data.

• Protect PII, financial information, health-related information where applicable, claims data, and other regulated or confidential data across its full lifecycle.

• Establish standards for data classification, encryption, key management, masking, tokenization, anonymization, pseudonymization, retention, deletion, and secure data sharing.

• Design and improve data access governance, including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access, row-level controls, column-level controls, and periodic access reviews.

• Partner with Data Platform and Analytics teams to embed security controls into data pipelines, warehouses, data lakes, reporting platforms, and machine learning workflows.

• Improve visibility into sensitive data stores, data flows, third-party transfers, and access patterns through discovery, monitoring, DLP, and related security tooling.

• Establish secure backup, recovery, and resilience requirements for critical data.

• Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical technical controls and measurable risk-reduction initiatives.

• Lead cross-functional prioritization, balancing urgent risk remediation with long-term data security maturity and SOC 2 readiness.

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. As our Incident Manager, you will be the cornerstone of Satispay's reliability and resilience. This role is crucial for protecting our user experience, maintaining business continuity, and driving the continuous improvement of our technology.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Orchestrate Incident Response - Take command during critical events from initial detection through to remediation. You'll serve as the central point of coordination, ensuring swift action, clear communication, and minimal service disruption.

title: Social Media Creative
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

*Open to hiring remote across North America. We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle.

We’re looking for an AI-Native Social Media Creative, a creative generalist who works natively with AI tools to produce exceptional short-form work for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X. Your background might be in editing, directing, design, animation, art direction or writing. What matters is that you’re already deeply embedded in AI-assisted creative workflows and are pushing the boundaries of what these tools can do. Editing is the core of the role, and you know how to cut short-form video that holds attention from the first frame to the last.

This is a making role. You’ll create work across formats, from short-form video and motion to design and editorial, using Runway’s products and the broader landscape of generative AI tools. Some days you’ll be cutting a launch-day Reel from generated footage. Other days you’ll be jumping on a trend the moment it breaks, building out tutorial content or exploring a creative application of a product feature no one’s tried yet. The output varies; the throughput and quality standard don’t.

Much of your work will sit at the top of the funnel, often as someone’s first encounter with Runway. It needs to stop the scroll, perform with the algorithm and feel native to each platform. You’ll also work in real time, turning model releases, trends and cultural moments into fast, reactive content while they’re still peaking.

You’ll sit within the creative department and report to the Social Media Lead. But the nature of the role means you’ll also work across product, research and marketing, often as the person who translates a product capability into a compelling creative artifact that’s geared to social audiences.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Create high-quality short-form video, motion, design and animation for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X using AI tools, primarily Runway’s own products

- Edit short-form content built to hold attention, from the opening hook through the final frame

- Develop concepts and execute finished work, not just prototypes, from initial idea through final output

- Create top-of-funnel content that stops the scroll and performs with each platform’s algorithm

- Respond to trends, news and cultural moments with fast, real-time content

- Explore and push the creative boundaries of generative AI tools, finding new techniques, workflows and visual languages

- Produce content across brand campaigns, product marketing, social, tutorials and internal demos

- Partner with product and research teams to translate new features and model capabilities into creative work that showcases what’s possible

If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. title: Data Architect (Datenarchitekt)
description:
Der Data Architect stellt sicher, dass die Daten unseres Unternehmens auch bei der Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsprozessen, Anforderungen und digitalen Lösungen strukturell korrekt, konsistent und geschäftlich relevant bleiben.
Es handelt sich um eine erfahrene Spezialistenrolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Daten und Technologie , mit klarer Verantwortung und Entscheidungsbefugnis hinsichtlich der Strukturierung und Modellierung von Daten.
Der Data Architect arbeitet eng mit Fachabteilungen und Fachexperten zusammen, um Geschäftsregeln zu verstehen und kritisch zu hinterfragen. Er übersetzt diese in robuste Datenmodelle und steuert deren Implementierung und Bewertung innerhalb unserer digitalen Lösungen.
Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass datenbezogene Entscheidungen einen zuverlässigen Betrieb, Reporting, Analysen und zukünftige Anwendungsfälle unterstützen.
Requirements
Datenmodellierung & Geschäftsregeln

• Verantwortung für die Entwicklung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der zentralen, unternehmensweiten Datenmodelle, einschließlich Definitionen, Beziehungen, Identifikatoren und Strukturen wichtiger Datenbereiche.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen und Fachexperten, um Geschäftsregeln zu verstehen, kritisch zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln. Übersetzung fachlicher, regulatorischer, produktbezogener und Reporting-Anforderungen in robuste und technisch umsetzbare Datenmodelle.

• Entscheidung darüber, wie vereinbarte Geschäftsregeln und Standards in Datenstrukturen abgebildet werden, einschließlich Abhängigkeiten, Beziehungen und Versionierung.

• Definition von Datenanforderungen und Vereinbarungen zum Datenaustausch zwischen Systemen sowie Dokumentation zentraler Datenmodelle und wesentlicher Datenarchitekturentscheidungen.

Datenintegrität & Auswirkungen von Änderungen

• Bewertung geplanter geschäftlicher, regulatorischer, inhaltlicher und produktbezogener Änderungen hinsichtlich ihrer Auswirkungen auf Datenmodelle, Integrationen und nachgelagerte Auswertungen.

• Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen zur Datenmodellierung und Datenintegrität. Identifikation widersprüchlicher Definitionen, redundanter Daten und Inkonsistenzen sowie Sicherstellung ihrer Behebung.

• Sicherstellung, dass Änderungen die Integrität und fachliche Bedeutung von Daten systemübergreifend und langfristig erhalten. Bei Bedarf Eskalation datenbezogener Architekturrisiken und übergreifender technischer Auswirkungen.

Lösungsentwicklung & Bewertung

• Steuerung der datenbezogenen Aspekte bei der Konzeption und Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen. Festlegung von Modellierungsvorgaben für Entwicklungsteams und Überprüfung der Implementierungen anhand vereinbarter Anforderungen an Datenmodellierung und Datenintegrität.

• Bewertung bestehender und potenzieller Softwarelösungen aus Datenarchitektursicht, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenmodellen, Schnittstellen, Integrationsmöglichkeiten, Zugänglichkeit und Eignung für geschäftliche Anforderungen.

• Kritisches Hinterfragen und gegebenenfalls Ablehnen technischer Ansätze, die die Datenintegrität gefährden, unnötige Redundanzen erzeugen oder langfristige technische Einschränkungen verursachen.

• Sicherstellung, dass Datenmodelle zuverlässiges Reporting, Analysen und unternehmensweite Datenprodukte unterstützen. Berücksichtigung zukünftiger Anforderungen an Automatisierung, Advanced Analytics und künstliche Intelligenz bei Architekturentscheidungen.

Der Data Architect verbindet enge Zusammenarbeit mit klarer Eigenverantwortung. Er berücksichtigt die Perspektiven relevanter Stakeholder, trifft jedoch innerhalb seines Fachgebiets eigenständige Entscheidungen.
Zu seinen Entscheidungsbefugnissen gehören:

• Festlegung, wie Geschäftsregeln und fachliche Konzepte in zentralen Datenmodellen abgebildet werden.

• Definition von Datenstrukturen, Beziehungen, Identifikatoren und Datenaustauschvereinbarungen innerhalb der vereinbarten Architekturvorgaben.

• Festlegung verbindliche

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator | US Healthcare | USA Hours
description:
ISTA Personnel Solutions South Africa is a dynamic and fast-growing BPO company based in South Africa, specialising in providing top-tier operational support to U.S.-based companies. We are not a recruitment agency - we act as a dedicated extension of our clients’ teams, delivering high-quality service with precision, efficiency, and a personal touch.
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join a busy recruitment team supporting a fast-growing US healthcare group. Our client runs behavioural health and healthcare facilities across several US states and is expanding quickly, so there’s always someone to find.
This is a salaried, in-house role with no commission structure. You won’t be closing deals or negotiating offers. Your job is to find great candidates, screen them quickly, and get the right people in front of the hiring managers. The managers do the final interviews and make the hiring decisions.
Who will thrive here:
You’re a go-getter with a sales-style mindset. You don’t give up after a few no-shows; you pick up the phone and keep going. You’re warm and easy to talk to, but you also know that being likeable isn’t enough. A candidate has to meet the requirements before they move forward. You stay organised in a fast-paced environment, and you can adapt when needs change from week to week.
PLEASE NOTE:

•
Working Hours: Monday - Friday, 4:00pm - 1:00am SAST (subject to daylight saving time).

•
Public Holidays: You will work on all South African public holidays. Compensated in line with the BCEA.

•
Internet Requirements: A fixed fibre line with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps (upload & download) and the ability to support a wired Ethernet connection is mandatory. Applicants without a fixed fibre line cannot be considered.

•
Power Backup: A reliable power backup solution is required to manage load shedding and power outages . Applicants without a power backup cannot be considered.

•
Work Environment: Fully remote (you must be located in South Africa)

Responsibilities:

• Hold weekly calls with facility contacts to confirm hiring needs.

•
Source candidates through the ATS and re-engage previous applicants when candidate flow slows.

• Screen candidates by phone, Zoom or Microsoft Teams , maintaining 18-20 interview slots per day (with overbooking to allow for no-shows).

• Keep your interview calendar full for the next 2-3 days .

• Verify that candidates meet role and state licensure requirements before progressing them.

• Book qualified candidates directly into hiring managers’ calendars .

• Use text message templates and scheduling links ( Calendly / Microsoft Teams Bookings ) to schedule efficiently.

• Guide candidates through step-by-step onboarding and track completion.

• Communicate proactively with facilities and the Director of Recruitment, flagging any drop in candidate flow early.

Requirements:

• At least 2 years’ experience in a phone-based, people-facing role (recruitment, sales, customer service or call centre)

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills .

• Strong organisational skills and calendar management skills.

• Comfortable working with computer systems and learning new ones quickly

• Resilient and self-motivated, with the drive to hit daily targets

Beneficial:

• Recruitment experience, especially high-volume or healthcare recruitment

• Experience with an ATS (Workday or similar)

• Familiarity with US healthcare roles or licensing requirements

• Experience with Calendly, Microsoft Teams or Zoom

If you are not contacted within 14 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, enterprise change, commercial judgment and client leadership.

As Director, Legal Engineering, your mission is to make Legal Engineering the commercial and delivery engine for the West Coast, anchored in our San Francisco office. Reporting to the Head of Legal Engineering, North America, you will set the craft bar, build the team and its Team Lead layer, partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement, lead selectively on the highest-stakes clients, and turn local learning into playbooks that scale across North America.

This is a Director-level leadership role. Your primary output will be the quality and performance of the team and system you build. You will stay close enough to the product and the work to coach credibly, while moving your own time toward hiring, leadership development, senior relationships, market strategy and cross-functional execution.

You will have the autonomy to shape how Legal Engineering runs in a strategically important market, together with the responsibility to keep that model connected to Legora's North American and global standards.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead the Legal Engineering function for the West Coast from the San Francisco office, including its operating rhythm, quality bar, capacity model and local partnership with Go-to-Market and Engagement.

- Hire exceptional Legal Engineers and future leaders. Own the quality bar from sourcing and interview calibration through closing, onboarding and ramp.

- Build a manager layer of Team Leads who each own and develop a group of Legal Engineers. Delegate real decision rights and create clear succession paths so the function becomes stronger and less dependent on you over time.

- Give direct, evidence-based feedback. Coach hard, set clear expectations and act decisively when the performance or values bar is not met.

- Partner with West Coast commercial leadership on priority accounts, pilots, rollouts and escalations. Connect Legal Engineering activity to conversion, adoption, usage, expansion and revenue.

- Act as the lead legal architect on selected enterprise engagements. Translate a real legal problem into a concrete Legora workflow, then turn successful delivery into a reusable playbook others can run.

- Oversee complex, multi-stakeholder programs with clear governance, owners, outcomes, leading indicators and risk management.

- Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, General Counsels, Heads of Innovation, Legal Operations leaders and other

title: Quality Assurance Test Analyst II
description:
Overview
The Quality Assurance Test Analyst is part of our growing cross-functional Agile development team, developing and supporting transactional websites which fully integrate with complex back-office legacy applications that drive core business processes.
Responsibilities

• Be part of a cross-functional team of Agile testers, developers, and business users.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field or equivalent experience.

• 5-8years of experience in system-level QA Testing.

• 5 years of experience in an Agile environment

• Working knowledge of Web application testing and/or Web service testing

• Familiar with all stages of the SDLC as well as Software Quality Assurance testing including System, Integration, Regression, Performance and User Acceptance Testing. An understanding of the concepts of Test Driven Development(TDD) and how it applies to Agile testing

• Ability to write and understand basic SQL queries to perform data verification and set up test dataExperience with testing tools such as QA Symphony qTEST, Borland Micro Focus Silk Central, HP Quality Center, Test Director, or similar.

• Experience using test automation frameworks i.e. Cucumber, FitNesse, TestNG, or Selenium
